profiles.formatter-preserve: preserve structure; no port/param sorting; no prefix autofix; no always split; no inline wire rewrite
profiles.formatter-normalize: force structural renderer; may rename/reorder/split/add bridges/rebuild header

comments.language: Chinese first; keep identifiers/protocol/timing terms as-is

placement_rules.forbid_block_comments: Any /* or */ marker is forbidden in deliverable Verilog.
placement_rules.same_line_alignment: Trailing // comments align to the current region banner right-side // display column; when code is longer, // may move right but never left of that anchor.
placement_rules.leading_comment_spacing: A block, definition-group, or instance-purpose comment is immediately above its target, aligns to the target start column, and has exactly one blank line above unless it directly follows a region banner.
placement_rules.case_branch_leading_comments: Inside `case(state_current)`, every `ST_*:begin` and `default:begin` branch uses a pure leading comment immediately above the branch label, aligned with the label column, and follows the same one-blank-line-or-region-banner rule as other leading comments.
placement_rules.assign_group_spacing: If a pure comment introduces an assign subgroup, it is optional, but once written it must have exactly one blank line above when preceded by code; stacked pure comments or a directly preceding region banner remain valid exceptions.
placement_rules.definition_group_comments: Parameter and signal definition groups require a pure group comment above the group; a region banner does not satisfy this requirement.
placement_rules.instance_comments: Each module instance requires a pure function comment above it, and each .formal(actual) mapping requires a same-line semantic comment.

statements.inline_wire_assign: forbidden; split into wire declaration plus assign
statements.sequential_reset: posedge clock or negedge active-low reset
statements.fsm: project requires three-segment FSM; formatter enforcement is partial
statements.fsm_next_state_hold: Default `state_next <= state_current;` before branch overrides; legacy `state_next = state_current;` remains gate-compatible during migration.
statements.fsm_next_state_branch_closure: Every if / else if chain in next-state combinational logic must end with an explicit else branch.
statements.fsm_next_state_operator_style: Prefer `state_next <= ...;` for newly generated next-state combinational logic; do not mass-rewrite legacy `=` solely for gate compatibility.

known_differences: packed width and identifier may be rendered without a separating space
flag semantic terms end/req/ack require generator/manual naming; formatter may not infer all
protocol-specific clock/reset names require generator/user override
instance naming convention is project-level, not strongly formatter-enforced
C model/range width inference is outside formatter scope
